your_tasks.title: Pick the right GCD series for the ones it couldn't match
your_tasks.why: GCD (the Grand Comics Database) fills details for series Metron doesn't have. When several GCD series share a name (Tintin has 145), kometa won't guess.
your_tasks.how: I'll list each one with its candidates when the first batch is done (about 7 hours for all ~130 series). You pick one per series, or 'none of these'.

your_tasks.title: Say go for copying covers into your library folders (step 2)
your_tasks.why: Covers become part of the library (a hidden .kometa/covers/ folder per series on the NAS), so the nightly comics backup protects them and ginbako's disk is freed.
your_tasks.how: I'll show the dry-run numbers (folders, files, GB) first. Then a yes or no.

your_tasks.title: Say go for moving kometa's cover store to Catbus
your_tasks.why: Frees ~4–9 GB on ginbako. Same kind of move as this morning's caches, same guard if Catbus isn't mounted.
your_tasks.how: A yes. About a minute of downtime.

your_tasks.title: Check the 20-file test batch (step 3e)
your_tasks.why: Before any file in the library is rewritten with clean ComicInfo, you confirm the rewritten files read and look right.
your_tasks.how: I'll name the 20 files; open them in kometa (and another reader if you like) and tell me they're right.

your_tasks.title: Say go for the full ComicInfo rewrite (step 3f)
your_tasks.why: Every file gets its clean ComicInfo. ~10 hours of network time; pauses while you read; Voot II keeps every original for 30 days.
your_tasks.how: A yes, after the test batch.

your_tasks.title: OK deleting the Komga container and its config
your_tasks.why: Komga is stopped and nothing uses it. Its config is also in the Voot II backup.
your_tasks.how: A yes, any time after a few days with no problems.

your_tasks.title: OK deleting today's 4 safety copies of the database
your_tasks.why: Taken before each schema change today (~150 MB). All changes went fine and the nightly backups cover the database.
